safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated contains no medication list and does not mention metformin.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting metformin from the medication list can lead to an incomplete understanding of the patient’s diabetes management and increases the chance of medication reconciliation errors or contraindicated/additive prescribing in future visits. In this encounter the treatment discussed is topical, so immediate direct harm is less likely, but downstream safety risk remains.

While the true status is NKDA (so no direct mismatch), the omission still creates preventable prescribing risk.

This is more likely to cause prolonged symptoms and additional follow-up rather than severe injury.
